analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($125.81) vs SMA5 ($133.78)/SMA20 ($137.36)/SMA50 ($147.06): below, confirming short- to mid-term weakness.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($140.76): indicating weakening medium- to long-term trend.
· 52-week position (17.4%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (49.0→38.9): entering oversold territory, indicating continued downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.4879→-0.7423): worsening, reinforcing bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $125.55): approaching lower band, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($120.39): aligning with 5-day low, acting as a key support level.
· Swing resistance ($147.60): significant distance from current price, breakthrough would signal bullish reversal.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: potential Lower High, maintaining bearish trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.00x): normal level, indicating moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis: Downtrend, conditions for entry: RSI recovery above 50 and MACD golden cross confirmation.
